reviews.author: Kris W.
reviews.text:
If you're looking for physical therapy from people who care and are knowledgeable, you've found the place!
I was seeking for ways to manage lower pain and PT Stephanie has been so helpful. She listens, gives pertinent instruction and provides guidance for ways I can strengthen my body at home between appointments.
Though recovery after injury or surgery can be a slow slog for me, it helps to have a professional companion for accountability and to be empowered by an incremental path toward feeling better. Stephanie offers this in spades and without judgment. I'm starting from square one, but there's hope!

reviews.author: Eileen L.
reviews.text:
Three therapy sessions to date, following total reverse shoulder surgery on 7/24.
Was treated by Stephanie and Darren. Excellent care!! Very proficient!

reviews.author: John M.
reviews.text: I have been receiving PT for foot, leg and knee pain and better balance and mobilization. Everyone is very friendly and professional. The sessions include stretching and strengthening exercises.

reviews.author: Maisy J.
reviews.text: Excellent staff, I have right knee pain and the doctor found greats ways to treat the pain! Great communication and nice new equipment!

reviews.author: Kathy D.
reviews.text: Fvpt is second to none in knowledge,friendliness and accomodations. Had hip replacement surgery and my PT staff is getting me back up and running. I would recommend to anyone looking for expert staff!

reviews.author: It's M.
reviews.text:
I absolutely recommend this place hands down. It is by far the best PT experience I have ever had. Everybody is friendly and my Therapist, Stephanie, makes me feel like she truly cares. She always makes sure I’m comfortable and we chit chat like we’re friends. I have Ankylosing Spondylitis and feel awesome when I leave. I was having some neck/shoulder/arm muscle and nerve issues that have improved a lot. It gets overwhelming to deal with this disease and I’m feeling optimistic again!
If I could go all the time, I would.

reviews.author: Troy A.
reviews.text: They work with the surgeons and make sure that you are comfortable. Very friendly. Thank you.

reviews.author: Shelly C.
reviews.text: I was referred to Fox Valley Physical Therapy..Thank You! I'm receiving great treatment on my knee replacements(many yrs ago) and getting my knees to finally bend!! Staff is Awesome! Service is Fantastic! Highly recommend!

reviews.text: Preston has been very attentive to my health issues and we just revisits I know I'm on the right path though my recovery May be very lengthy.
